Chapter 867: Chapter 11: Within A Turn Of The Hand (Subscribe Please)

Chapter 867: Chapter 11: Within a Turn of the Hand (Subscribe Please)

As the greatest genius in the history of Human Civilization, Lin Yuan knew many powerful individuals.

Many Alien Strong Ones longed to establish connections with the Galaxy Master.

Not only because of the Human Civilization but also because of Lin Yuan’s own potential.

With the cultivation speed demonstrated by Lin Yuan…

He was the life form in this era with the most hope of reaching the ultimate peak, advancing to Level Eleven.

The Galaxy Master was certainly among them.

Who wouldn’t want to establish a good relationship with a future Level Twelve ultimate being?

Why does Sizhong Ancient God hold a transcendent status in the Cosmic Starry Skies? Why even peak groups are reluctant to pressure too much?

Isn’t it because this Ancient God ‘sponsored’, at one time, those who had not yet reached Level Twelve ultimate?

But knowing is just knowing, the ones that can be called ‘acquaintances’, especially Alien Strong Ones, are not many.

Lin Yuan looked at the powerful fighters thousands of miles away who were engaged in a fierce battle.

One side was from the Insect Race, and the other was from the Prison Tribe.

Both were forces of peak groups; although there were only four from the Insect Race side.

Still, three of them were from the Insect Race Hive, summoning a large number of Level Eleven Insect Race Warriors, binding the five strong Prison Tribe fighters without regard to their own lives.

From the momentum, even though the numbers of the Insect Race were fewer than the Prison Tribe, they were still suppressing the latter.

…

“Tuoba Ancient God…”

Lin Yuan watched one of the figures, this figure belonged to the Insect Race side, mingled among many Insect Race Warriors, pressuring the five besieged Prison Tribe.

It was indeed Tuoba Ancient God.

Lin Yuan had quite an impression of this Ancient Starry Sky Deity.

Initially, he had taken away his friend Fang Qing’s mind will, using it to ‘blackmail’ Lin Yuan in hopes of obtaining resources to reach the ultimate level.

Later, in the Two-dimensional World, Lin Yuan seized the opportunity to kill Tuoba Ancient God once, but it was only an avatar that died.

Now, having just entered the core battlefield area, he has encountered this Ancient Starry Sky Deity again.

“It’s quite coincidental, then another death it shall be.”

A smile appeared on Lin Yuan’s face.

Although there was no way Lin Yuan could have been ‘blackmailed’ successfully by Tuoba Ancient God.

But this feeling of being threatened made him very uncomfortable, and now that he had met him again, he naturally wouldn’t let him go.

Not to mention, Tuoba Ancient God’s allegiance to the Insect Race Alliance, which is an enemy of the Human Civilization Alliance.

Even without Tuoba Ancient God, Lin Yuan would crush him conveniently.

…

Over a vast mountain range, the Space-Time Rule fluctuations surged, five Level Eleven Prison Tribe powerful beings furrowed their brows, killing large amounts of successive Insect Race Warriors while also fending off the soul attacks from the three Insect Race Hives.

And Tuoba Ancient God’s ambush.

“These bugs are really annoying.”

“Big brother, let’s use the ultimate weapon.”

A Prison Tribe strong one with horns on his head communicated telepathically.

“Use the ultimate weapon?”

The leader of the Prison Tribe hesitated for a moment.

Ultimate weapons are mass-destruction weapons, a trump card.

It shouldn’t be used lightly; the energy required to activate ultimate weapons is considerable.

But considering the current situation… if they continue to be deadlocked, there is no meaning, they can only use ultimate weapons to break out of the encirclement of Insect Race Warriors.

…

“Tuoba, they are going to activate their ultimate weapons.”

On the Insect Race side, one of the Insect Race Hives seemed to sense something and immediately communicated telepathically with Tuoba Ancient God.

“I know.”

Tuoba Ancient God’s expression was solemn, always ready to use the ultimate weapon he possessed.

While waiting for the right moment, Tuoba Ancient God swiftly thought, “How is that Galaxy Master so strong? To be able to kill Ming Che?”

Tuoba Ancient God felt regret at this moment.

Originally, he thought that with his own strength, coupled with the ultimate weapon bestowed by the Insect Race, he would not have any problems surviving on the battlefield.

But he did not expect that many peak group powers, for the control over this massive battle arena, basically used all their trump cards. The Insect Race Alliance, situated as the ruler on the battlefield, absolutely possessed the power to suppress the usual holders of ultimate weapons at Level Eleven.

This is something the Queen of the Insect Race did not tell him before entering the battlefield.

Compared to Insect Race members, Tuoba Ancient God, as a special life form, belongs to outsiders, many intelligence secrets are not known.

Actually, hiding some battlefield secrets, for Tuoba Ancient God, isn’t really a big deal.

Given the intensity of a massive battlefield war can be unimaginably high.

With Tuoba Ancient God’s own strength, plus the ultimate weapon, there is still a great chance of surviving.

Although Tuoba Ancient God is only Level Eleven fifth tier, he came personally with true form, which is much stronger than an avatar, especially some of his trump cards, which probably could compare to a Level Eleven Perfect.

But the strength of the Galaxy Master was too terrifying.

Tuoba Ancient God had no doubt that if the Galaxy Master encountered him on the battlefield, he certainly would not hesitate to strike.

“I’m here in person this time, I cannot take any risks, once I reach the war base of the Insect Race Alliance, I’ll just hide inside and not come out.”

Tuoba Ancient God has already made up his mind, even if this would cost him a lot of merit, but life is the most important.

In fact, when he learned about the strength of the Galaxy Master, Tuoba Ancient God thought of withdrawing from the massive battlefield.

But once you enter the battlefield, there’s no turning back unless you endure until the different phases of the war progress, there is absolutely no possibility of leaving halfway.

Buzz!

On the Prison Tribe side, a terrifying fluctuation emerged, the leading Prison Tribe strong being’s hand produced an ‘artifact’ tower weapon, a golden aura began to spread in all directions.

“Rise.”

Tuoba Ancient God also swiftly activated a gray ‘bell’, a defensive ultimate weapon, but also possessing the power to suppress.

Just as the auras of the ultimate weapons from both sides were about to collide.
